name: BibleCard
title: BibleCard
summary: A black-leather Bible cover with a gold tooled border that presents one language's Bible: native name, dot.bible address, Read / Listen / Order / Get the app tiles and a QR share, plus a compact row for lists.
whenToUse: Use the full card `.sx-bible` as the hero of a dot.bible language page or the featured language in the homepage directory.
Use the compact row `.sx-bible sx-bible-row` in a short list of featured languages.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for long language lists (hundreds of rows); use LanguageRow.
Do not use the leather surface for anything that is not a Bible.

anatomy.description: Leather surface → head (native name + URL) → four action tiles → gold rule → QR share. Compact row: The leather texture comes from `--sx-leather` (default `url("../assets/imagery/leather-black.jpg")`, falls back to `#121212`). Set `--sx-leather` on a parent if the asset path differs.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card`: full leather cover with tiles and QR share. `row`: compact row for short lists.

props.name: nativeName
props.description: Language name in its own script.

props.name: nativeLang
props.description: BCP 47 code of the native name, for example "am".

props.name: nativeDir
props.description: Set "rtl" for Arabic-script and Hebrew names.

props.name: url
props.description: Address line, for example "dot.bible/amharic". In the row variant pass "Amharic · dot.bible/amharic". Short addresses, no https://.

props.name: languageName
props.description: English name of the language, used in accessible names ("Ways to get the Amharic Bible").

props.name: read
props.description: Read action. The only Horizon Blue tile.

props.name: listen
props.description: Listen action.

props.name: order
props.description: Order (print) action. Full card only.

props.name: app
props.description: Get the app action. Full card only.

props.name: actionsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the tile group (full card), for example "Ways to get the Amharic Bible".

props.name: readLabel
props.description: Row variant: accessible name of the Read tile, for example "Read the Amharic Bible".

props.name: listenLabel
props.description: Row variant: accessible name of the Listen tile, for example "Listen to the Amharic Bible".

props.name: pageHref
props.description: Row variant: link to the language page (the gold ↗).

props.name: pageLabel
props.description: Row variant: accessible name of the ↗ link, for example "Open the Amharic language page".

props.name: qrSrc
props.description: Precomputed QR image URL for the share block. No QR library is bundled. Use this or `qr`.

props.name: qr
props.description: Precomputed QR as an inline `<svg>` or other node, used instead of `qrSrc`.

props.name: qrLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the QR naming the address, for example "QR code for dot.bible/amharic".

props.name: shareTitle
props.description: Share block title, for example "Share with someone nearby".

props.name: shareText
props.description: Share block prompt.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: Visible label of the Copy link button.

props.name: shareLabel
props.description: Visible label of the Share button.

props.name: onCopyLink
props.description: Called when Copy link is pressed.

props.name: onShare
props.description: Called when Share is pressed.

props.name: status
props.description: Share status announced politely, for example "Link copied: dot.bible/amharic".

props.name: url
props.description: The dot.bible address under the name, e.g. "dot.bible/amharic".

props.name: actionsLabel
props.description: Names the tile group: "Ways to get the Amharic Bible".

props.name: onRead
props.description: Read. The one Horizon Blue tile.

props.name: onListen
props.description: Listen.

props.name: onOrder
props.description: Order.

props.name: onGetApp
props.description: Get the app.

props.name: qr
props.description: QR code element (for example from QrShare); drawn on a white 128dp tile. Give it its own label through `qrLabel`.

props.name: qrLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the QR, naming the address: "QR code for dot.bible/amharic".

props.name: shareTitle
props.description: Share title.

props.name: shareCopy
props.description: Share copy under the title.

props.name: onCopyLink
props.description: Copy link action; shows the Copy link button when set.

props.name: onShare
props.description: Share action; shows the Share button when set.

props.name: status
props.description: Status after copying, e.g. "Link copied: dot.bible/amharic". Announced politely, in gold.

variantNotes: Full card: four tiles in a row; under 480px a 2 × 2 grid with icon beside label (72px), and the QR beside stacked full-width Copy link / Share.
Compact row `.sx-bible-row`: native name 24px, two 44px `.sx-bible-mini` tiles and a gold ↗.
Action tile `.sx-bible-act` (88px tall, white): default, hover (`--gray-200`), focus (2px `--leather-gold` outline). Primary `.sx-bible-act-primary` is Horizon Blue.
Share status: after Copy link, the status line reads "Link copied: dot.bible/amharic" in `--leather-gold`.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Exactly one Horizon Blue tile per card: Read (`.sx-bible-act-primary` or `.sx-bible-mini.p`).
Keep the cover shape: square spine corner on the left (10px dark spine), 32px radius on the right, gold double border inset 12px.
Gold (`--leather-gold`) for eyebrow, rule, status and the ↗; focus rings on leather are gold, not blue.
Native name first and largest (`--font-sans` 600, 32–44px); English name and URL below in `--text-secondary-dark`.
Tiles go to other pages, so the compact row ends with ↗.
Share buttons are `.btn-outline-light btn-sm`; never a second blue button.
All tiles and buttons meet the 44px tap target.

Use the compact row `.sx-bible sx-bible-row` in a short list of featured languages.

accessibility: Set `lang` (and `dir="rtl"` where needed) on the native name.
Name the tile group: `aria-label="Ways to get the Amharic Bible"`.
Icon-only compact tiles carry full labels ("Read the Amharic Bible").
The QR is `role="img"` with an `aria-label` that names the address; always offer Copy link beside it.
The copy confirmation sits in `role="status"` so it is announced.
content: Native script name only in the title (አማርኛ, မြန်မာဘာသာ); English in the URL line for the row ("Amharic · dot.bible/amharic").
Tile labels: Read, Listen, Order, Get the app.
Share copy: "Share with someone nearby" / "Point a phone camera at the code to open the Amharic Bible instantly."
